evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3509359 is a 125.08 USD online product-R purchase in billing region 264.0 on 2016-12-03 06:04:26. Card C12265-K2 is a visa debit owned by C12265.
Region 264.0 has 82 prior purchases on this card before the alert.
Closed cases on this card: CC-2277 (confirmed_fraud, account_takeover); CC-2447 (confirmed_fraud, account_takeover).
Device Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080 is also linked to 2 other card(s): C02354-K2, C02923-K1.
Email domain cox.net also links 4 other card(s): C03042-K1, C05876-K2, C08623-K2, C09933-K2.
Billing region 264.0 appears on 17 other cards in the local 1-hop fan-out. Region sharing is recorded, not treated as proof of a shared origin.
Episode reconstruction grouped 3 transactions around 3509359 using history, device, amount outliers, and NEXT edges 3501890, 3510096.
R6 Shared origin: Several cards with fraud associated with the same device profile, billing region, or recipient email: CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, and MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS for every affected card.
Account takeover: Mixed-channel behavior inconsistent with the cardholder, often with device and match-flag anomalies. Stolen credentials, not only a stolen card number.

Closed case CC-0255: Case CC-0255: cardholder C02354 reported unrecognized activity on card C02354-K2. 7 transaction(s) between 2016-07-06 and 2016-07-08 totaling $1,167.08 were confirmed fraudulent. Mixed-channel activity inconsistent with the cardholder; credentials and card data both used. Online transactions came from a iOS Device on mobile safari 10.0. Card blocked and reissued. Customer reimbursed.

FFIEC authentication guidance: FFIEC guidance expects layered authentication. A new device or credential change on an online purchase is a reason to step up authentication, not automatic proof of fraud.

sar.narrative: On 2016-11-30, card C12265-K2 belonging to customer C12265 was used for a 125.08 USD online transaction 3509359 in billing region 264.0, country 87.0. The product code was R. Episode reconstruction identified 3 related transaction(s) totaling 476.03 USD from 2016-11-30 to 2016-12-03. Graph neighborhood review found this activity inconsistent with the cardholder's established pattern or linked it to a shared origin, email cluster, or mixed-channel takeover. Online purchase 3509359 used a device not seen on this card, shortly after in-person activity. That mixed-channel shift is treated as stolen credentials rather than a stolen card number alone. The investigation treated the purchase as unauthorized. Connected cards recommended for monitoring: C02354-K2, C02923-K1, C03042-K1, C05876-K2, C08623-K2, C09933-K2. The flagged card is recommended for restriction pending reissue. Total unauthorized amount: 476.03 USD. This report is filed so a regulator can review the episode on its own.

stop_reason: Fraud probability 0.89 is supported by 2 independent pieces of evidence.
